name: Nexa Blocks – Gutenberg Blocks, Page Builder for Gutenberg Editor & FSE
author: wpdive

sections.description:
NexaBlocks is Gutenberg Blocks Library extends the Gutenberg functionality with several unique and feature-rich blocks that help build websites faster. You don’t need to have any coding knowledge to build eye-catching websites. It’s for a better page-building experience without the need for traditional page builders like Elementor and Divi.

Quick Links 🔗

  • Do you want to see Nexa blocks in action before installing? SEE NEXA BLOCKS DEMO
  • New to the Gutenberg Blocks Ready Templates? Checkout our SEE NEXA TEMPLATE LIBRARY
  • Need any help with setup? Checkout our DOCUMENTATION
  • Interested in Nexa Pro? Here are more details about NEXA PRO

Key Features

👉 Finest Gutenberg blocks plugin

👉 Fastest loading assets for icons, fonts, and templates

👉 Perfectly works with Full Site Editor

👉 Native interface for WordPress blocks

👉 Draggable container width inside block editor

👉 Copy paste styles across blocks

👉 Intuitive drag-and-drop functionality

👉 Responsive design for mobile, desktop & tab

Nexa Free Blocks: Effortless Page and Post Design in Gutenberg

✅ Slider: Stunning, awesome slideshows effortlessly. Highlight key content with beautiful transitions and customizable styles to captivate your audience.

✅ Advanced Tabs: Create awesome content layouts.

✅ Container: Create structured content layouts.

✅ Advanced Heading: Add customizable text headings.

✅ Icon Box: Insert icons with text and style options.

✅ Social Icons: Include social media icons and links.

✅ Button: Insert customizable buttons for call-to-action purposes.

✅ Social Share: Enable easy content sharing on social media.

✅ Advanced Accordion: Create collapsible content sections on the page and post.

✅ Image Accordion: Create collapsible content sections on the page and post.

✅ Google Maps: Display a location you want to share to your website visitor.

**Upgrade To NexaBlocks Pro And Experience Page Builder Features In Gutenberg Block Editor**

👑 Amazing Flip Box

👑 Dynamic Slider

👑 Custom CSS
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin files to the /wp-content/plugins/nexablocks directory, or install the plugin through the WordPress plugins screen directly.
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ screen in WordPress
sections.faq:
Does NexaBlocks requires Gutenberg plugin to be installed?

It does not required Gutenberg plugin. WordPress version 5.9 or above already have Gutenberg integrated so you can use NexaBlocks without installing Gutenberg.

Why do you need to use a page builder along with Gutenberg?

A page builder like NexaBlocks offer more rich features and flexibility, which you can’t enjoy only using Gutenberg.

Is NexaBlocks responsive for all screens?

Yes, it is fully responsive for all devices and tested for cross-browser compatibility.

Who can benefit from NexaBlocks?

WordPress users who like to use Gutenberg will love all the advanced and cool blocks of the plugin.

Does NexaBlocks compatible with other Gutenberg plugins?

NexaBlocks should be compatible with other Gutenberg plugins, some popular plugins we have checked already.
